columns.benchmark: Canonical benchmark name, or a tool-native backend case.
columns.runtime_seconds: Wall-clock time measured by the adapter.
columns.logical_depth: Tool-native slice, cycle, or routing-layer count.
columns.max_footprint: Maximum reserved logical sites when available.
columns.occupied_patch_time_volume: Sum of occupied logical sites over time when available.
columns.native_volume: Volume reported by the upstream implementation.
columns.data_density: Logical data locations divided by max_footprint when meaningful.
columns.notes: Metric caveats, validation result, or blocking reason.
